sanskrit_verse:
यथाकथंचिद्दत्त्वा गां धेनुं वाधेनुमेव वा ।
अरोगामपरिक्लिष्टां दाता स्वर्गे महीयते ॥१.२०८॥
transliteration: yathākathaṃcid dattvā gāṃ dhenuṃ vādhenum eva vā / arogām aparikliṣṭāṃ dātā svarge mahīyate // YajñS_1.208
sph_interpretive_translation: One who gives, in any manner whatsoever, a cow, a bull, or even a heifer — healthy and unburdened — that giver is exalted in svarga.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through conscious giving aligned with Dharma
Causation arises from intent and capacity to sustain life
Capacity-based responsibility is measured by ability to give without depletion
Restoration logic operates through elevation of consciousness via dharmic action
Consciousness alignment occurs when gift aligns with recipient's evolutionary need
executable_legal_axioms: IF (agent.gives AND object.isLivingEntity AND object.isHealthy AND object.isUnburdened) THEN agent.consciousness.elevation = TRUE
IF (gift.integrity.preserved AND recipient.alignment.validated) THEN transaction.dharmic.value = MAXIMUM
IF (giver.capacity.depleted = FALSE AND recipient.integrity.restored = TRUE) THEN social.dharma.index.increment()
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, the threshold of responsibility lies not in ownership but in the capacity to give without diminishment. Authority is validated through consciousness elevation, not material control. Restoration supersedes punitive frameworks by recognizing the act as inherently constitutional to Dharma.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that the cause of elevation is the unburdened state of the gift. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that consciousness follows the integrity of the act. Responsibility is proportional to the purity of intention and absence of burden on the gift. The reality rule confirms that no punitive overlay exists where Dharma is spontaneously fulfilled.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Validate that the gift was given without coercion or expectation
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Confirm giver’s awareness of consequence and elevation
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Ensure giver remains unburdened post-gift
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Align recipient’s use of gift with dharmic evolution
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores the eternal principle of giving as consciousness elevation. Reality is non-punitive; Dharma is executed through spontaneous alignment. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
